meanings.en: to try to win or do better than others
meanings.exampleEn: Several companies compete for the same customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç şirket aynı müşteriler için rekabet ediyor.

meanings.en: involving competition or eager to win
meanings.exampleEn: He has a very competitive nature and hates to lose.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok rekabetçi bir yapısı var ve kaybetmekten nefret ediyor.

meanings.en: a person or company that competes with others
meanings.exampleEn: Our main competitor has lowered its prices.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana rakibimiz fiyatlarını düşürdü.

meanings.en: something that completes or goes well with another
meanings.exampleEn: The wine is a perfect complement to this meal.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarap bu yemeğin mükemmel bir tamamlayıcısıdır.

meanings.en: totally; in every way
meanings.exampleEn: I completely forgot about the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıyı tamamen unuttum.

meanings.en: having many connected parts; not simple
meanings.exampleEn: The human brain is an incredibly complex organ.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsan beyni inanılmaz derecede karmaşık bir organdır.

meanings.en: to make something more difficult or confusing
meanings.exampleEn: Let's not complicate things by adding new rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kurallar ekleyerek işleri karmaşıklaştırmayalım.

meanings.en: difficult to understand or deal with
meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were too complicated to follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Talimatlar takip edilemeyecek kadar karmaşıktı.

meanings.en: to write music, or to make up something
meanings.exampleEn: She composed a song for her sister's wedding.
meanings.exampleTr: Kız kardeşinin düğünü için bir şarkı besteledi.

meanings.en: the parts that make up something, or a written work
meanings.exampleEn: The chemical composition of the rock was analyzed.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayanın kimyasal bileşimi analiz edildi.

meanings.en: a substance made of two or more elements
meanings.exampleEn: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
meanings.exampleTr: Su, hidrojen ve oksijenden oluşan bir bileşiktir.

meanings.en: the ability to focus all your attention
meanings.exampleEn: Solving the puzzle requires great concentration.
meanings.exampleTr: Bulmacayı çözmek büyük bir konsantrasyon gerektirir.

meanings.en: a general idea about something
meanings.exampleEn: The concept of time is hard to explain to children.
meanings.exampleTr: Zaman kavramını çocuklara açıklamak zordur.

meanings.en: worried about something
meanings.exampleEn: Many parents are concerned about online safety.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok ebeveyn çevrimiçi güvenlik konusunda endişeli.

meanings.en: to decide something after thinking, or to finish
meanings.exampleEn: The judge will conclude the trial tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakim duruşmayı yarın sonuçlandıracak.

meanings.en: the end of something or a decision reached
meanings.exampleEn: We reached the conclusion that the plan would fail.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın başarısız olacağı sonucuna vardık.

meanings.en: the way a person behaves
meanings.exampleEn: His conduct during the meeting was very professional.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı sırasındaki davranışı çok profesyoneldi.

meanings.en: belief in yourself or your abilities
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with great confidence in front of the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın önünde büyük bir özgüvenle konuştu.

meanings.en: to say that something is definitely true
meanings.exampleEn: Please confirm your booking by email.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen rezervasyonunuzu e-posta ile teyit edin.

meanings.en: a statement that something is true or definite
meanings.exampleEn: We received confirmation of the order this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Siparişin onayını bu sabah aldık.

meanings.en: a serious disagreement or fight
meanings.exampleEn: There was a conflict between the two countries over the border.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ülke arasında sınır konusunda bir çatışma vardı.

meanings.en: difficult to understand
meanings.exampleEn: The map was so confusing that we got lost.
meanings.exampleTr: Harita o kadar kafa karıştırıcıydı ki kaybolduk.

meanings.en: a state of not understanding or being uncertain
meanings.exampleEn: There was a lot of confusion about the new schedule.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni program hakkında çok fazla karışıklık vardı.

meanings.en: to praise someone for an achievement
meanings.exampleEn: I want to congratulate you on your new job.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni işin için seni tebrik etmek istiyorum.

meanings.en: to join two or more things together
meanings.exampleEn: Please connect the printer to your computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen yazıcıyı bilgisayarınıza bağlayın.

meanings.en: a link or relationship between things
meanings.exampleEn: There is a clear connection between smoking and disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara içmek ile hastalık arasında açık bir bağlantı var.

meanings.en: to take control by force, or to overcome
meanings.exampleEn: The army managed to conquer the city in a week.
meanings.exampleTr: Ordu şehri bir hafta içinde fethetmeyi başardı.

meanings.en: awake and aware of what is happening
meanings.exampleEn: The patient was still conscious after the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta kazadan sonra hâlâ bilinçliydi.

meanings.en: as a result of something
meanings.exampleEn: He missed the train and consequently arrived late.
meanings.exampleTr: Treni kaçırdı ve sonuç olarak geç geldi.

meanings.en: the protection of nature and resources
meanings.exampleEn: Wildlife conservation is important for future generations.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaban hayatının korunması gelecek nesiller için önemlidir.

meanings.en: preferring traditional ideas and not liking change
meanings.exampleEn: My grandparents have very conservative views.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannem ve büyükbabamın çok muhafazakâr görüşleri var.

meanings.en: large in size, amount, or degree
meanings.exampleEn: They spent a considerable amount of money on the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve hatırı sayılır miktarda para harcadılar.

meanings.en: careful thought about something
meanings.exampleEn: After careful consideration, we accepted the offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Dikkatli bir değerlendirmeden sonra teklifi kabul ettik.

meanings.en: a letter that is not a vowel
meanings.exampleEn: The letter 'b' is a consonant.
meanings.exampleTr: 'b' harfi bir ünsüzdür.

meanings.en: all the time; again and again
meanings.exampleEn: My phone is constantly ringing today.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonum bugün sürekli çalıyor.

meanings.en: to be or form something
meanings.exampleEn: Women constitute half of the workforce.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadınlar iş gücünün yarısını oluşturuyor.

meanings.en: the basic laws and principles of a country
meanings.exampleEn: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Anayasa ifade özgürlüğünü güvence altına alır.

meanings.en: to build something
meanings.exampleEn: The workers will construct a new bridge next year.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler gelecek yıl yeni bir köprü inşa edecek.

meanings.en: the process of building something
meanings.exampleEn: The construction of the new school took two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni okulun inşaatı iki yıl sürdü.

meanings.en: to use up or eat and drink something
meanings.exampleEn: Modern cars consume less fuel than older ones.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern arabalar eski olanlardan daha az yakıt tüketir.

meanings.en: the act of using, eating, or drinking something
meanings.exampleEn: Water consumption increases during the summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Su tüketimi yaz aylarında artar.

meanings.en: to have something inside
meanings.exampleEn: This drink does not contain any sugar.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu içecek hiç şeker içermiyor.

meanings.en: happening repeatedly, again and again
meanings.exampleEn: The continual noise from the road kept me awake.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoldan gelen sürekli gürültü beni uyanık tuttu.

meanings.en: repeatedly; very often
meanings.exampleEn: She continually interrupts me when I speak.
meanings.exampleTr: Ben konuşurken sürekli sözümü kesiyor.

meanings.en: happening without stopping
meanings.exampleEn: There was a continuous flow of traffic all day.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün gün kesintisiz bir trafik akışı vardı.

meanings.en: without any breaks or stops
meanings.exampleEn: The machine ran continuously for ten hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine on saat boyunca kesintisiz çalıştı.

meanings.en: completely different or opposite
meanings.exampleEn: His opinion was contrary to everyone else's.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun fikri herkesinkine zıttı.

meanings.en: to give something, such as money or help
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone should contribute to the discussion.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes tartışmaya katkıda bulunmalı.

meanings.en: something given to help achieve something
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution to the project was very valuable.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun projeye katkısı çok değerliydi.

meanings.en: causing strong disagreement
meanings.exampleEn: The new law is highly controversial.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa son derece tartışmalı.

meanings.en: to make someone believe or agree
meanings.exampleEn: I tried to convince her to stay longer.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu daha uzun kalmaya ikna etmeye çalıştım.

meanings.en: the legal right to control a creative work
meanings.exampleEn: The author owns the copyright to her books.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazar, kitaplarının telif hakkına sahiptir.

meanings.en: a change that makes something right
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher made several corrections to my essay.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen kompozisyonumda birkaç düzeltme yaptı.

meanings.en: a soft white material used to make cloth
meanings.exampleEn: This shirt is made of pure cotton.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu gömlek saf pamuktan yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: a group chosen to manage or advise
meanings.exampleEn: The city council voted to build a new park.
meanings.exampleTr: Belediye meclisi yeni bir park yapmak için oy kullandı.

meanings.en: professional advice to help with problems
meanings.exampleEn: The school offers free counseling for students.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, öğrenciler için ücretsiz danışmanlık sunuyor.

meanings.en: the total number of something
meanings.exampleEn: The final count of votes was announced.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyların nihai sayımı açıklandı.

meanings.en: too many to be counted
meanings.exampleEn: She has read countless books about history.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarih hakkında sayısız kitap okudu.

meanings.en: a region or administrative area of a country
meanings.exampleEn: They live in a small village in Kent county.
meanings.exampleTr: Kent ilçesinde küçük bir köyde yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: the ability to do something that frightens you
meanings.exampleEn: It took a lot of courage to speak the truth.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçeği söylemek çok cesaret gerektirdi.

meanings.en: showing bravery in a difficult situation
meanings.exampleEn: The courageous firefighter saved the child.
meanings.exampleTr: Cesur itfaiyeci çocuğu kurtardı.

meanings.en: a long green vegetable, also called zucchini
meanings.exampleEn: I added some courgette to the pasta sauce.
meanings.exampleTr: Makarna sosuna biraz kabak ekledim.

meanings.en: an activity needing skill with your hands
meanings.exampleEn: Pottery is an ancient craft.
meanings.exampleTr: Çömlekçilik eski bir el sanatıdır.

meanings.en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something
meanings.exampleEn: Three people were injured in the car crash.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba kazasında üç kişi yaralandı.

meanings.en: a person who makes or invents something
meanings.exampleEn: She is the creator of a popular video game.
meanings.exampleTr: O, popüler bir video oyununun yaratıcısıdır.

meanings.en: a time of great danger or difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: The country is facing an economic crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke ekonomik bir krizle karşı karşıya.

meanings.en: a person who judges books, films, or art
meanings.exampleEn: The film critic praised the new movie.
meanings.exampleTr: Film eleştirmeni yeni filmi övdü.

meanings.en: extremely important, or expressing criticism
meanings.exampleEn: The next few hours are critical for the patient.
meanings.exampleTr: Önümüzdeki birkaç saat hasta için kritik.

meanings.en: a plant grown by farmers for food
meanings.exampleEn: Wheat is an important crop in this region.
meanings.exampleTr: Buğday bu bölgede önemli bir üründür.

meanings.en: a place where you can safely cross a road
meanings.exampleEn: Always use the pedestrian crossing to cross the street.
meanings.exampleTr: Caddeyi geçmek için her zaman yaya geçidini kullanın.
